SELECT 
    order_date,
    status,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_date, status
ORDER BY order_date
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) as month,
    SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) as sales_amount
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) IN ('2025-09', '2025-10', '2026-09', '2026-10')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)
ORDER BY month

SELECT 
    (SELECT sales_amount FROM (
        SELECT SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) as sales_amount
        FROM orders
        JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
        WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
          AND strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = '2026-10'
    )) - 
    (SELECT sales_amount FROM (
        SELECT SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) as sales_amount
        FROM orders
        JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
        WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
          AND strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = '2026-09'
    )) as sales_change

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(qty * unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
     AND oi.product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE category_id = 1)) AS digital_sales,
    (SELECT SUM(qty * unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')) AS total_sales

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
     AND oi.product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE category_id = 1)) AS digital_sales,
    (SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')) AS total_sales,
    (SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
     AND oi.product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE category_id = 1)) / 
    (SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')) * 100 AS digital_percentage

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN 1 END) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
